title: User does not understand technical terms
symptom: User is confused by the technician's technical language
user_description: You said I need to 'check the cache and restart the daemon'. I'm sorry, I don't understand any of that.

options.text: Use more technical terms so she takes you seriously
options.why: Confuses her more and makes her feel foolish. Clear communication matters more than sounding clever.

options.text: Use plain words and short steps, ask what she can see on screen, and check she is following
options.why: Plain language and one step at a time let her follow along. Asking what she sees confirms she is on the right track.

options.text: Tell her to search for the terms online
options.why: Passes the work to the user and shows poor service. Explaining is your job.

hints: How would you explain this to a friend with no IT background?
How do you know the user has understood?
real_world_tip: Keep asking 'What do you see now?' It keeps the user involved and shows you where they got lost.
